description: This file defines a React component for editing tool permission rules, including the configuration data structures, default values, and the UI for managing rules such as tool name/type, decision, and allowed parameter patterns.

methods.name: ensureConfig
methods.description: Function to ensure the config object has default values, filling in missing fields.

methods.name: ToolPermissionRulesEditor
methods.description: React functional component for editing tool permission rules, managing multiple rules, and specific rule details.

methods.name: addRule
methods.description: Adds a new rule to the current configuration.

methods.name: removeRule
methods.description: Removes a specified rule from the configuration.

methods.name: updateRule
methods.description: Updates a specific rule with new data.

methods.name: updateAllowedParamEntries
methods.description: Updates the allowed_param_patterns entries for a specific rule.

methods.name: updateAllowedParamPath
methods.description: Updates the path for a specific allowed parameter pattern entry.

methods.name: updateAllowedParamPattern
methods.description: Updates the pattern for a specific allowed parameter pattern entry.
